annotations.title: Typical contaminant levels for a kind of food

description: For a kind of food (a category slug such as milk, rice, baby-infant-foods-beverages, cereal, water), returns FDA's typical levels of metals and perchlorate, whether FDA's foods are a close or rough stand-in, and the products in that category with lab results: the 50 lowest in the most-tested chemical by default (products below the lab's limit first), with tested_total giving the full count. Pass sort to rank by another chemical, order=high for highest first, and all=true for every tested product.

all.description: Optional: true returns every tested product instead of the first 50

order.description: Optional: "high" for highest first (default lowest first)

sort.description: Optional chemical slug to rank by, e.g. "lead" (default: the chemical tested in the most products)

name: food_category
title: Typical contaminant levels for a kind of food
